headline: The IRA Donation Trick That Lowers Your Tax Bill and Never Touches Your Medicare Premium
summary: Most retirees taking RMDs have no idea a single distribution can silently trigger hundreds of dollars in Medicare surcharges, and the window to stop it closes on December 31 with no appeal available afterward.
